title: The Farmers' Museum
content: Brooks Barn, Farmers' Museum, gouache, 5 x 5 inchesTheFarmers' Museumof Cooperstown, New York demonstrates the daily business of a 19th century farm.You can watch — and sketch — as re-enactors milk cows, make cheese, harvest garlic, weave cloth, and print pamphlets.
